title: Hive Routing Workbench customer commissioning

task.name: Commission a complete GraphQL routing edition, reviewed native client programme and independently received operator installation
task.purpose: Give a customer application owner a usable deployment and change process that preserves complete GraphQL source/configuration, every selected client operation, original router responses, explicit acceptance and rollback, with a customer agent and full editable receiving.
task.request: Receive the actual Workshare and Installation case, customer application owner, source-use authority, selected subgraphs and complete client programme. Retain the complete original configuration, supergraph, operations document and every supporting file. Prepare or receive the pinned Hive v0.3.4 runtime with its actual Linux architecture, independent Python/PyYAML installation and full source authority. Open the original operator through Applications. Review every native configuration feature against its selected source, preserving private environment references and actual routing/authentication behavior. Prepare a separate native deployment from the complete edition, explicitly start it and observe the original attempt and readiness. Run every agreed client operation under one stable original run_id, retain full request/response bodies, HTTP statuses/headers and GraphQL data/errors. Review every operation on its actual native attempt. Create a real changed edition, run and compare the complete programme, resolve differences and explicitly cut over the stable endpoint only to the accepted current attempt. Demonstrate the original prior-deployment rollback and a complete rollback programme. Use the same original state and whole files through the private Merchant customer agent, preserving exact mutation intent and original entity-revision recovery. Stop the original router explicitly when the operating plan requires closure. Export the complete original source/SQLite history/CAS as a named ZIP, inspect all members and independently receive to a new directory. Prepare that receiving host’s own native runtime, reopen the original history and use a new reviewed local native attempt only when authorized. Enter Installation acceptance from actual completed operations.
task.completeOutput: One commissioned routing service and accepted original/changed customer edition, all agreed sources and native client operations, complete original responses and differences, configuration/result decisions, actual cutover/rollback history, managed UI and21-tool customer agent, plus complete independently received editable source/runtime/workspace delivery.
task.repeatTrigger: One distinct authorized configuration, schema, subgraph, client-operation or business release change creates a useful later linked task. Replaying a lost request, reading pages, downloading formats, reopening a stopped listener and repeated source transfer remain the same original task.
task.pricedUnit: One agreed complete application-routing commissioning or accepted release edition, with the actual selected subgraph/operation population and receiving scope. Keep original Installation merchant unit, integer atomic amount/count/budget and approved spending fields. Additional subgraphs, live dependencies, hosting, ongoing operations and connector/adaptor changes require explicit customer terms.

source.reference: Retain current Workshare and Installation seed, complete customer source directory/edition.json, configuration, supergraph and hive-desk-operations/v1, original file names/media/bytes/SHA and acquisition authority. Record native edition/deployment/attempt/programme/review/active-endpoint IDs without substituting summaries.
source.mode: The original Python Hive application and SQLite event chain operate the exact published GraphQL Hive Router v0.3.4 for Linux x64 or arm64. The complete original reference uses the pinned upstream Rust fixture with four genuine subgraphs and twenty selected operations per initial, changed and rollback programme. Customer programmes retain their own agreed full population.
source.population: Every selected edition member and every agreed original operation, including expected failures, HTTP errors, GraphQL data/errors/extensions and complete non-JSON bodies. Full artifacts are retained up to2GiB and structured action/state inspection up to32MiB; larger legitimate work requires an explicit complete partition or delivery design, not a sample presented as the whole result.
source.meaning: Retain the exact operation method/path/body/public headers and private environment-variable references, native attempt, elapsed observation and full original response. Review expected error outcomes in their real application context. Complete comparison preserves added/removed operations, request/header/status changes and all JSON differences; body equality alone is not business acceptance.
source.changePolicy: Import complete immutable editions, retain all original files when creating a changed edition, and save reviews with original expected entity revisions. Native deployment IDs bind edition, exact binary, environment names and installation. New process attempts require new actual programme/review before endpoint selection. Full workspace archives preserve event-chain ancestry and receive only to fresh directories.

receiving.application: TJLabs Hive Routing Workbench,64 complete original source files from Commons b3b6f57d92c8e704e789728576a3bd95caf40fe6 and complete capsule b05be1ed42b57b447178682f584abb4fa0a6b5c9, with the declared maintained server factory and actual stopped/earlier-installation endpoint wording and retained displayed-review revision. Installed under products/hive-routing-workbench/workbench. Commands hive-routing-workbench, hive-routing-workbench-prepare, hive-routing-workbench-managed and hive-routing-workbench-receive. The external original-source.json binds every selected source member and both pre/post maintenance identities.
receiving.acceptanceRule: All selected original sources and native runtime files match the full authority; each configured feature and every client operation has a complete reasoned review. Actual native initial/changed/rollback results, complete difference report and current-attempt endpoint decision are retained. Managed browser and customer agent use the same workspace and original effects. Full ZIP/source/runtime independently receive and reopen while preserving all original IDs. The producing peer operates and looks at the exact outgoing desktop/mobile screens, downloads, attachments and reopened exports before presentation. Existing native owner remains sole until its actual course closes.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: Use original expected entity revision and explicit decision reason for reviews and endpoint changes. Applications Stop joins the original HTTP listener and request handlers; it does not cancel detached accepted native router processes. Use native.stop, observe native.status and native.reconcile under original deployment lease. Preserve incomplete/ambiguous programme rows and original logs; do not resubmit actual side-effecting GraphQL requests just to obtain a cleaner receipt. Receiving never overwrites current history.
receiving.recovery: The adapter persists exact host request, resolved host aliases and before-state, then closes a full response candidate before publication. Hive Controller has no requestId interface. Repeating the same adapter request reopens a confirmed response or checks a matching saved effect. Review/activation retries use the exact unchanged original entity revision; uncertain changed targets remain explicit. Partial changed directories and ambiguous native network rows stay retained for reconciliation. Actual HTTP errors may follow partial effects. Inspect the original state and files before deliberately selecting a new request.
receiving.maintenance: Assign application/subgraph owner, native operator, review/acceptance owner, customer-agent host and independent receiver in the original case. Deliver complete editable source, original licenses, actual router/Python/PyYAML runtime and complete native history. Private environment values and connection nonce stay outside public exports. Preserve the original company offer/contact and single native reference operation. Registration conveys no vendor endorsement and creates no extra purchased tasks.

steps.title: Receive the complete application Workshare
steps.result: Select actual application/subgraph/client/receiver owners, source authority, complete scope and original commercial/Installation fields. Retain the current seed and approved pricing/budget without manufacturing observations.

steps.title: Prepare the exact source and native runtime
steps.result: Verify all64 maintained source members and all declared source maintenance. Independently prepare the published Hive binary and PyYAML6.0.3 Python environment, retain complete portable input and actual runtime receipt.

steps.title: Import the complete original edition
steps.result: Bind every file in edition.json and its complete source directory. Retain actual configuration, supergraph and all selected client operations; verify their full file identities.

steps.title: Review the real configuration
steps.result: Record one decision and engineering reason for every native configuration feature. Preserve original listener, authentication, header, routing, limits, telemetry and private environment reference meaning.

steps.title: Run the original baseline programme
steps.result: Prepare/start the exact local native deployment, observe actual attempt/readiness and run every agreed operation using its stable run_id. Retain full HTTP and GraphQL results, including expected errors.

steps.title: Create and exercise the real changed edition
steps.result: Retain all supporting files and complete authored replacements, prepare the changed deployment and run the whole agreed programme. Compare every operation and complete result difference against baseline.

steps.title: Accept and switch the exact native attempt
steps.result: Review every operation and its actual programme revision. Cut over only to a ready current attempt supported by accepted configuration/result reviews, retaining the previous endpoint binding.

steps.title: Demonstrate original rollback
steps.result: Select an actually retained previously serving deployment, operate its original current attempt and retain the complete rollback programme, review and comparison. Stop only explicitly selected native owners.

steps.title: Operate through the customer agent
steps.result: Use declared editions, binary and archive aliases; inspect complete state/entities, preserve request/effect distinction, and download whole native bodies/source/archives by exact SHA and byte pages.

steps.title: Independently receive complete source and history
steps.result: Export, inspect and compare the whole ZIP. Receive to a fresh directory, preserve older/current/forward/diverged history and original engine/source. Reopen with the receiving host’s own native/runtime selection.

steps.title: Inspect the outgoing product and record acceptance
steps.result: Operate and view the exact desktop/mobile UI and all outgoing attachments, complete downloads and reopened exports. Record actual Installation/native/output/acceptance identities and the next useful customer release task.

inputs: Actual customer Workshare/Installation seed, existing phases, assignments, approved terms and accountable application/subgraph/native/acceptance/receiving owners.
Complete original edition directory and file inventory, configuration, supergraph and full selected client programme with source-use authority.
Exact64 source selection/provenance and original licenses; pinned published Hive v0.3.4 binary and independently installed Python/PyYAML6.0.3 runtime.
Original private environment names and authorized existing values, local listener/port selection, separate private launch and host aliases.
Actual native deployment/attempt/readiness, complete original request and response files, logs and every selected client result.
Configuration and result reviews with exact entity revisions; complete comparison and actual endpoint cutover/rollback history.
Named full editable ZIP, retained runtime package, full independent receiving/cold reopen and actual rendered-product inspection.
Actual merchant/buyer, network/asset/recipient, integer atomic amount/count/budget and authorized spending selection.
